title: iShowSpeed Completes Every Easter Egg In GTA 6

clips.title: We Found the Alien... It Was KSI
clips.hook: He found an ALIEN in GTA 6
clips.reason: Huge reaction, clear surprise reveal (KSI), and a satisfying punchline ending — self-contained and screams rewatch.

clips.title: The Craziest Voicemail in GTA 6
clips.hook: This skunk ape voicemail is unhinged
clips.reason: Absurd, hilarious scripted monologue that's fully self-contained and extremely quotable.

clips.title: He Actually Found Bigfoot in GTA 6
clips.reason: Clean buildup, clear discovery, funny 'National Geographic' punchline — very shareable and standalone.

clips.title: Aliens Left Her Naked in GTA 6
clips.hook: What did the aliens do to her?!
clips.reason: Shocking, funny, confusing moment that's fully understandable alone with a clear comedic hook and reaction.

clips.title: KSI's Cousin Might Be Dead
clips.hook: I think I just killed KSI's cousin
clips.reason: Tense chaotic sequence with a hilarious, standalone punchline at the end.

clips.title: Y'all Lied to Me the Whole Time
clips.hook: The chat betrayed him in GTA 6
clips.reason: High energy and funny chat-interaction payoff, but repetitive screaming drags the hook a bit.
